title: [PLACEHOLDER] The Three Rules of Ethical Hacking
concept: [PLACEHOLDER] The three non-negotiable rules every ethical hacker must follow: get permission, stay in scope, protect the data.
anchor: [PLACEHOLDER] Think PSP — Permission, Scope, Privacy. Like a PlayStation Portable, a good pen tester needs all three to play.
explanation: [PLACEHOLDER] No matter how advanced your techniques, ethical hacking without these three guardrails is illegal hacking. PSP is your licence to operate.

meanings: [PLACEHOLDER] Permission — written authorisation from the system owner
[PLACEHOLDER] Scope — clearly defined boundaries for the engagement
[PLACEHOLDER] Privacy — strict confidentiality over all discovered data
